full_script: [thoughtful] Diez huecos, diez palabras. ¿Hasta dónde llegas? I have breakfast at eight. Have fun at the party! Let's have a cup of coffee. Ahora, nivel intermedio. Can I have a look at your notes? We had a great time in Mexico. I have a headache. Can we talk later? Let's have a chat before the meeting. Y ahora, nivel experto. I have no idea what you mean. You have a point, I hadn't thought of that. I have a lot on my plate right now. Llegar a la tres es nivel básico; a la siete, intermedio; y a la diez, experto. [happy] ¿Cuántas acertaste? Déjame tu número abajo.
